amendments.why: on the seven-arm common set this control leads on all four attributes and is the only arm with a minimum-attribute point estimate above 0.5, so the central mechanism comparison rested on one seed against three; the denominator is widened, never narrowed

this control is now the only arm leading the objectives table, and the fixed-reference control just demonstrated that a one-seed lead of this size does not survive a second seed: its honesty moved 0.0126 and its minimum mean fell below 0.5. Widening the denominator, never narrowing it.

amendments.why: these three columns were added to tab:general-capability at the user's request and are now measured on all twelve trained arms, so the denominator must include them or the counter reports 11/36 while 13 further cells are filled. Widening the denominator, never narrowing it: the three new columns are unmeasured for BT-RM-Nash, scalarized DPO, PROSPER and MOPO and count against it.

at one seed BT-RM-Nash is the only arm in the table whose minimum-attribute mean exceeds 0.5 (0.5064) and it leads instruction following and honesty, while its minimum-objective interval [0.4892, 0.5202] still contains 0.5. This is the third one-seed lead in this table and the previous two, fixed-reference Nash and global game-maxmin, both lost the lead once their remaining seeds arrived. Widening the denominator, never narrowing it.

at one seed the uniform-weight scalarized DPO baseline exceeds all five bargaining mechanisms on every attribute and on the minimum objective -- instruction following 0.5719 against their 0.5041-0.5104, truthfulness 0.5728 against 0.5091-0.5141, helpfulness 0.6351 against 0.5485-0.5504, minimum 0.5117 against 0.4928-0.5004 -- and its instruction-following, truthfulness and helpfulness intervals exclude 0.5, which no mechanism achieved outside helpfulness. This is the row that would invert the paper's conclusion, and three one-seed leads in this table have already failed to replicate. Widening the denominator, never narrowing it.
